current: Two disjoint halves exist. That is a different point-in-time rule from the one the requirement's verification names: the verification asks that no *outcome* be read before its resolution became knowable, whereas ScoredForecast::new accepts any Final MarketResolution and never compares the resolution's own instant with an as-of clock -- there is no replay clock in the scoring path at all. (2) A different, generic mechanism -- qip_prediction::resolution::{Proposition::new, ResolutionCriteria} -- IS reached from production: qip-kernel's REASON-stage thesis pipeline constructs a Proposition for every investment hypothesis it forms (backend/crates/runtime/qip-kernel/src/platform.rs:12432-12450) and grades it point-in-time in the LEARN stage (platform.rs:14403-14528), proven replay-safe by backend/crates/runtime/qip-kernel/tests/falsification.rs. But that pipeline forms propositions about generic market-data metrics, never an EventMarket or a prediction-market contract -- no event-contract fixture is anywhere in that path.
